title.zh: 矩形区域不超过 K 的最大数值和
title.en: Max Sum of Rectangle No Larger Than K

desc.zh: 把矩形压成一行，再寻找最小的合法历史前缀。
desc.en: Compress rectangles into rows and find the smallest eligible earlier prefix.

complexity: O(a² b²) time; O(b) auxiliary space, a=min(m,n), b=max(m,n)

concepts.name: Row-band compression
concepts.description: Each rectangle becomes an interval in a fixed row band.

concepts.name: Eligible earlier prefix
concepts.description: Choose the smallest earlier q ≥ P−k before inserting P.
